This message indicates that there's a feedback issue with the SMC (Switchgear Monitoring and Control) system connected to a converter group. Specifically, the feedback from one or more SMCs is either "ON" or "OFF" unexpectedly, which is causing the converter group to be disabled. The likely cause is that the converter group at the opposite end of the faulty SMC is still enabled, leading to a mismatch or fault in the system's operation.
